description.zh: 以图搜图应用实例ID。可调用[QueryPictureSearchApps](~~206608~~)查询。
description.en: Instance ID of the image search application instance. You can call [QueryPictureSearchApps](~~206608~~) to query instance ID.

description.zh:
设备IotId列表。支持传入V系列边缘一体机或摄像头的IotId。

IotId是物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。可调用物联网平台[QueryDeviceDetail](~~69594~~)查询。

单次最多可填写20个设备IotId。
description.en:
The list of device IotIds. You can specify the IotId of a V series edge server or a camera.

The IotId is the unique identifier issued by IoT Platform for the device. You can call the [QueryDeviceDetail](~~69594~~) operation of IoT Platform to query the IotId.

You can specify up to 20 device IotIds in a single request.

description.zh:
实例ID。

- 企业版实例：必须传入此参数。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看您的企业版实例ID。
- 公共实例：无需传入此参数。
description.en:
The instance ID.

- Enterprise Enterprise instance: This parameter is required. You can view the ID of your Enterprise Enterprise instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.
- Public instance: You do not need to specify this parameter.

title.zh: 解绑图片搜索应用程序与设备
title.en: Unbind devices from an image search application

descriptions.zh:
## 使用限制
如果在企业版实例中调用该接口，请求参数**IotInstanceId**必须填写。否则，调用接口会失败。
descriptions.en:
## Limits
If you invoke this operation on an Enterprise instance, you must specify the **IotInstanceId** request parameter. Otherwise, the invocation failed.
